```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Analysis constants ----------------------------------------------------------
n_net <- 6
net_ind <- c("indegree", "outdegree", "betweenness", "eigen")

bribery_behav <- c("BE", "BE_TP", "BEE", "BEE_TP")
filler_behav <- c("donate", "RD", "TG", "TPP")

scaling <- "none"
rsa_dist <- "euclidean"
seed_value <- 27

# Defaults reproduce the manuscript analyses. Override these environment
# variables only for quick code checks.
n_perm_lmer <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("RSA_LMER_PERM", "2000"))
n_perm_mantel <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("RSA_MANTEL_PERM", "5000"))

source("../0_preprocessing/0.i_import_data.R", local = TRUE)
source("1.0_RDM_helpers.R", local = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(igraph)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

if (rsa_dist == "euclidean") {
  post_final[, net_index_all] <- scale(post_final[, net_index_all])
}

# Keep RDM row/column labels aligned with the filtered participant order.
rownames(post_final) <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(post_final)))
id_levels <- rownames(post_final)
participant_ids <- as.character(post_final$node_id)

network_cats <- c("fr", "da", "si", "oi", "pc", "nc")
network_names <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)
names(network_names) <- network_cats

network_cols <- paste0("network.", network_cats)
distance_cols <- paste0("distance.", network_cats)

behavior_labels <- c(
  BE = "TT_abs",
  BE_TP = "TT_pres",
  BEE = "J_abs",
  BEE_TP = "J_pres"
)

centrality_labels <- c(
  indegree = "In-degree",
  outdegree = "Out-degree",
  betweenness = "Betweenness",
  eigen = "Eigenvector"
)

plot_data_dir <- file.path("..", "99_visualization", "results", "rsa")
dir.create(plot_data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper-functions}
make_rdm <- function(df, which_dist = rsa_dist, scale_output = TRUE) {
  out <- df %>%
    my_RDM(which_dist = which_dist) %>%
    filter(var1 < var2) %>%
    arrange(var1, var2) %>%
    mutate(dist = as.numeric(dist))

  if (scale_output) {
    out <- out %>% mutate(dist = as.numeric(scale(dist)))
  }

  out
}

fit_rdm_model <- function(df, y_col, x_cols) {
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste0(y_col, " ~ ", paste(x_cols, collapse = " + "), " + (1 | var1) + (1 | var2)")
  )
  lmerTest::lmer(formula, data = df, REML = FALSE)
}

extract_lmer_results <- function(model, digits = 4) {
  coefs <- coef(summary(model))
  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", colnames(coefs), value = TRUE)
  p_value <- if (length(p_col) == 1) coefs[, p_col] else NA_real_
  ci <- suppressMessages(confint(model, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_"))
  ci <- ci[match(rownames(coefs), rownames(ci)), , drop = FALSE]

  tibble(
    term = rownames(coefs),
    beta = coefs[, "Estimate"],
    SE = coefs[, "Std. Error"],
    LL = ci[, 1],
    UL = ci[, 2],
    t = coefs[, "t value"],
    p = p_value
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(beta, SE, LL, UL, t), ~ round(.x, digits)),
      p = ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), p))
    )
}

RDM_regression_perm <- function(df, x_cols, y_col, B = 2000, seed = seed_value) {
  ids <- sort(unique(c(as.character(df$var1), as.character(df$var2))))
  n_subjects <- length(ids)
  i <- match(as.character(df$var1), ids)
  j <- match(as.character(df$var2), ids)

  y_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n_subjects, n_subjects, dimnames = list(ids, ids))
  y_mat[cbind(i, j)] <- df[[y_col]]
  y_mat[cbind(j, i)] <- df[[y_col]]
  diag(y_mat) <- 0

  model <- fit_rdm_model(df, y_col, x_cols)
  beta_obs <- coef(summary(model))[x_cols, "Estimate"]

  set.seed(seed)
  perm_beta <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(x_cols), ncol = B, dimnames = list(x_cols, NULL))

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    perm_id <- sample.int(n_subjects)
    df_perm <- df
    df_perm[[y_col]] <- y_mat[perm_id, perm_id][cbind(i, j)]

    perm_model <- fit_rdm_model(df_perm, y_col, x_cols)
    perm_beta[, b] <- coef(summary(perm_model))[x_cols, "Estimate"]

    if (B >= 200 && b %% 200 == 0) message("Permutation ", b, "/", B)
  }

  tibble(
    term = x_cols,
    beta_obs = as.numeric(beta_obs),
    p_perm = map_dbl(seq_along(x_cols), function(k) {
      (sum(abs(perm_beta[k, ]) >= abs(beta_obs[k])) + 1) / (B + 1)
    }),
    perm_sd = apply(perm_beta, 1, sd)
  )
}

add_permutation_p <- function(model_results, perm_results) {
  model_results %>%
    left_join(perm_results %>% select(term, p_perm), by = "term") %>%
    mutate(
      p_perm = ifelse(
        is.na(p_perm),
        NA_character_,
        ifelse(p_perm < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.4f", p_perm))
      )
    )
}

standardize_finite <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  out[ok] <- as.numeric(scale(x[ok]))
  out
}

rdm_to_symmetric_matrix <- function(rdm, n_subjects, value_col = "dist") {
  mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n_subjects, n_subjects)
  mat[cbind(rdm$var1, rdm$var2)] <- rdm[[value_col]]
  mat[lower.tri(mat)] <- t(mat)[lower.tri(mat)]
  diag(mat) <- 0
  mat
}

```

```{r centrality-rdms}

behav_control_rdm <- make_rdm(post_final[filler_behav])

RDM_merge <- tibble(
  !!!setNames(map(network_rdm_list, "dist"), network_cols),

  behav.filling = behav_control_rdm$dist,
```

## Distance-Based RDMs

```{r distance-rdms}
graph_distance_rdm <- function(g, ids, mode = "all") {
  missing_ids <- setdiff(ids, igraph::vertex_attr(g, "name"))
  if (length(missing_ids) > 0) {
    stop("These node_id values are missing from the graph: ", paste(missing_ids, collapse = ", "))
  }

  dmat <- igraph::distances(g, v = ids, to = ids, mode = mode, weights = NA)
  diag(dmat) <- 0

  as.data.frame(dmat, optional = TRUE) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("var1_id") %>%
    pivot_longer(-var1_id, names_to = "var2_id", values_to = "raw_distance") %>%
    mutate(
      var1 = match(var1_id, ids),
      var2 = match(var2_id, ids),
      raw_distance = as.numeric(raw_distance)
    ) %>%
    filter(var1 < var2) %>%
    arrange(var1, var2)
}

distance_rdm_raw_list <- map(seq_len(n_net), function(i) {
  graph_distance_rdm(
    g = SNmF_igraph[[i]],
    ids = participant_ids,
    mode = "all"
  )
})
names(distance_rdm_raw_list) <- network_cats

# Mantel tests use each network's own finite dyads.
distance_rdm_list_mantel <- map(distance_rdm_raw_list, function(x) {
  x %>% mutate(dist = standardize_finite(raw_distance))
})

# Distance-based IS-RSA uses a single common dyad set: remove the union of
# disconnected dyads across all six networks.
keep_distance_dyad_isrsa <- Reduce(
  `&`,
  map(distance_rdm_raw_list, ~ is.finite(.x$raw_distance))
)

distance_rdm_list_isrsa <- map(distance_rdm_raw_list, function(x) {
  x %>%
    filter(keep_distance_dyad_isrsa) %>%
    mutate(dist = as.numeric(scale(raw_distance)))
})

distance_df <- as_tibble(setNames(map(distance_rdm_list_isrsa, "dist"), distance_cols))

behav_bribe_distance_rdm <- make_rdm(post_final[bribery_behav], scale_output = FALSE) %>%
  filter(keep_distance_dyad_isrsa) %>%
  mutate(dist = as.numeric(scale(dist)))

behav_control_distance_rdm <- make_rdm(post_final[filler_behav], scale_output = FALSE) %>%
  filter(keep_distance_dyad_isrsa) %>%
  mutate(dist = as.numeric(scale(dist)))

RDM_merge_distance <- distance_df %>%
  mutate(
    behav.bribeall = behav_bribe_distance_rdm$dist,
    behav.filling = behav_control_distance_rdm$dist,
    var1 = factor(distance_rdm_list_isrsa[[1]]$var1, levels = id_levels),
    var2 = factor(distance_rdm_list_isrsa[[1]]$var2, levels = id_levels)
  )

distance_missing_summary <- bind_rows(
  imap(distance_rdm_raw_list, function(x, nm) {
    tibble(
      network = nm,
      network_name = network_names[[nm]],
      total_dyads = nrow(x),
      disconnected_dyads = sum(!is.finite(x$raw_distance)),
      disconnected_prop = disconnected_dyads / total_dyads
    )
  })
)

distance_isrsa_filter_summary <- tibble(
  total_dyads = length(keep_distance_dyad_isrsa),
  retained_dyads = sum(keep_distance_dyad_isrsa),
  removed_union_dyads = sum(!keep_distance_dyad_isrsa),
  removed_union_prop = removed_union_dyads / total_dyads
)

distance_missing_summary
distance_isrsa_filter_summary
```

## Distance-Based Mantel Tests

```{r distance-mantel}
mantel_one_network <- function(distance_rdm, behavior_rdm, n_subjects, n_perm = 5000,
                               method = "pearson", seed = seed_value) {
  distance_mat <- rdm_to_symmetric_matrix(distance_rdm, n_subjects)
  behavior_mat <- rdm_to_symmetric_matrix(behavior_rdm, n_subjects)

  upper_idx <- upper.tri(distance_mat)
  keep_obs <- upper_idx & is.finite(distance_mat) & is.finite(behavior_mat)
  r_obs <- suppressWarnings(cor(distance_mat[keep_obs], behavior_mat[keep_obs], method = method))

  set.seed(seed)
  perm_r <- replicate(n_perm, {
    perm_id <- sample.int(n_subjects)
    behavior_perm <- behavior_mat[perm_id, perm_id]
    keep_perm <- upper_idx & is.finite(distance_mat) & is.finite(behavior_perm)
    suppressWarnings(cor(distance_mat[keep_perm], behavior_perm[keep_perm], method = method))
  })

  tibble(
    mantel_r = r_obs,
    p_perm = (sum(abs(perm_r) >= abs(r_obs), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) / (sum(!is.na(perm_r)) + 1),
    n_perm = n_perm,
    n_total_cells = sum(upper_idx),
    n_used_cells = sum(keep_obs),
    n_removed_cells = sum(upper_idx) - sum(keep_obs)
  )
}

behav_bribe_mantel_rdm <- make_rdm(post_final[bribery_behav])
behav_control_mantel_rdm <- make_rdm(post_final[filler_behav])

mantel_distance_results <- bind_rows(
  imap(distance_rdm_list_mantel, function(distance_rdm, network_code) {
    bind_rows(
      mantel_one_network(distance_rdm, behav_bribe_mantel_rdm, length(participant_ids), n_perm_mantel) %>%
        mutate(behavior_rdm = "Bribery Behavior RDM"),
      mantel_one_network(distance_rdm, behav_control_mantel_rdm, length(participant_ids), n_perm_mantel) %>%
        mutate(behavior_rdm = "Control Behavior RDM")
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        network = network_code,
        social_network = network_names[[network_code]],
        .before = 1
      )
  })
)

mantel_distance_results
```

## Centrality-Behavior Correlation Data

```{r centrality-behavior-correlations}

network_names <- c(
  "Friendship",
  "Daily-activity",
  "Personal life-sharing",
  "Gossip-sharing",
  "Positive-cooperation",
  "Negative-cooperation"
)
names(network_names) <- network_cats

centrality_labels <- c(
  indegree = "In-degree",
  outdegree = "Out-degree",
  betweenness = "Betweenness",
  eigen = "Eigenvector"
)

behavior_labels <- c(
  BE = "TT_abs",
  BE_TP = "TT_pres",
  BEE = "J_abs",
  BEE_TP = "J_pres"
)

cor_method <- "spearman"

cor_with_p <- function(x, y, method = "spearman") {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]

  if (length(x) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(x) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(y) < 2) {
    return(c(r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x, y, method = method, exact = FALSE))
  c(r = unname(test$estimate), p = test$p.value)
}

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < .001 ~ "***",
    p < .01 ~ "**",
    p < .05 ~ "*",
    p < .10 ~ "+",
    TRUE ~ ""
  )
}

network_behavior_correlation <- function(i) {
  expand.grid(
    centrality = net_index_by_net[[i]],
    behavior = bribery_behav,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cor_stats = map2(centrality, behavior, ~ cor_with_p(post_final[[.x]], post_final[[.y]])),
      r = map_dbl(cor_stats, "r"),
      p = map_dbl(cor_stats, "p"),
      sig = p_to_stars(p),
      label = ifelse(is.na(r), "", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), sig)),
      network = factor(unname(network_names[i]), levels = unname(network_names)),
      centrality_type = sub("_[0-9]+$", "", centrality),
      centrality_type = factor(centrality_type, levels = net_ind, labels = centrality_labels[net_ind]),
      behavior = factor(behavior, levels = bribery_behav, labels = behavior_labels[bribery_behav])
    ) %>%
    select(-cor_stats)
}

centrality_behavior_cor <- map_dfr(seq_len(n_net), network_behavior_correlation)

stopifnot(nrow(centrality_behavior_cor) == n_net * length(net_ind) * length(bribery_behav))

centrality_behavior_cor
```

```{r negative-cooperation-summary}
negative_cooperation_mean_cor <- centrality_behavior_cor %>%
  filter(network == "Negative-cooperation") %>%
  summarise(
    n_correlations = sum(!is.na(r)),
    mean_r = mean(r, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_r = mean(abs(r), na.rm = TRUE),
    significant_cells = sum(p < .05, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

negative_cooperation_mean_cor
```
